Package ch.ahdis.matchbox.validation.gazelle

Class GazelleApiV1Mapper

java.lang.Object
ch.ahdis.matchbox.validation.gazelle.GazelleApiV1Mapper
public class GazelleApiV1Mapper extends Object
Reads and writes the models of the Gazelle Validation Service API v1, while the models of this package follow v2.

Both versions describe the same things, v2 renamed a few fields and added some others. Instead of maintaining a second set of models, the v1 JSON is produced with Jackson mix-ins:

  • request and report: validationItems (v1) is inputs (v2);
  • item: role (v1) is id (v2), mimeType is v2 only;
  • report: modelVersion is 0.1;
  • v2-only fields are omitted: profile version, standards and inputs, method validationProfileName, counters numberOfUndefined, assertion subjectLocations.
Author:
Oliver Egger
